schema.note: Additive, reversible. Apply `alembic upgrade head` to a real DB; the test suite provisions schema via Base.metadata.create_all.

root_universe_ref.current_population: Qualified against the bundled slm (س ل م) structural fixture only; the full Quran root universe requires the QAC morphology corpus (see blockers).
root_universe_ref.coverage: RootUniverseService.occurrence_coverage(db, snapshot_id, root, evidenced_refs) — exact-set, no threshold.
root_universe_ref.holdout: RootUniverseService.holdout_split / holdout_available — deterministic, guarantees a held-out occurrence when >=2 exist.

root_semantic_unity.coverage_rule: UNIVERSAL scope requires supported==eligible (exact set); no majority/percentage path exists.
root_semantic_unity.coverage_basis: supporting evidence only; counterevidence occurrences never satisfy coverage.
acceptance_guards: UNIVERSAL ROOT_CONCEPT with any unresolved_cases cannot be ACCEPTED
UNIVERSAL ROOT_CONCEPT with any eligible counterevidence occurrence cannot be ACCEPTED
root_semantic_unity.deferred_to_request_02: Reconcile author-declared unresolved_cases against the confirmed StructuralToken occurrence set at the gate (deterministic cross-check). Percentage bypass is already impossible; this only removes residual reliance on honest omission.

external_hypothesis_capabilities.isolation: Hypothesis.origin (write-once) marks INDEPENDENT_INTERNAL_DERIVATION vs EXTERNAL_CANDIDATE; external-origin hypotheses are excluded from the blind AI internal context.

accepted_memory_ref.reopen: reopen_accepted_results_for_new_evidence — ACCEPTED -> REOPEN_REQUIRED with revision bump + audit lineage

campaign_state_ref.resume: CampaignStateService.resume(db, campaign_id) — reads only the durable row; no conversation context
campaign_state_ref.checkpoint: CampaignStateService.checkpoint_root — idempotent; persist after every root

readiness_gate.reviewed_by: Phase 0B adversarial self-review (5 independent lenses) + Phase 0C remediation

tests.e2e_note: tests/e2e/* require Node/Next.js build + Playwright; environment-heavy, not part of this backend gate.

known_nonblocking_limitations.detail: The QAC morphology corpus is SOURCE_ROLE_PENDING with an unreconciled license (GPLv3 / CC terms); the artifact bytes are external and uncommitted. Without it, a full-Quran Root Universe and real per-root structural profiles cannot be populated. Capabilities are qualified against the bundled slm fixture. Resolving requires an external license/permission not available to the runtime.
known_nonblocking_limitations.unblock_condition: Owner reconciles QAC license and admits the morphology artifact (hash-bound), then a real QAC importer persists structural_tokens for the full corpus.

known_nonblocking_limitations.detail: The unity gate blocks on declared unresolved_cases and on eligible counterevidence occurrences; it does not yet auto-reconcile declared unresolved_cases against the confirmed StructuralToken set. No percentage bypass exists; this only removes residual reliance on honest omission and needs real structural data to be meaningful.
RootDescriptiveProfileService.tokens_from_qac parses QAC features simply; harden (split on '|' then ':', validate root alphabet) when a real QAC distribution is admitted.

irreducible_blockers: QAC_MORPHOLOGY_DATA_ABSENT (see known_nonblocking_limitations; blocks full-scale campaign, not the foundation)
owner_decisions_open_not_required_now: Calibration batch size and mandatory-per-root robustness tests

request_02_start.then: Seed runtime from CANONICAL_CORPUS_ADMISSIONS; derive Root Universe; per root build RootDescriptiveProfile; run internal discovery under isolation; enforce root semantic unity; test external hypotheses via the register; persist via CampaignState after every root.
request_02_start.hard_stop_if: QAC_MORPHOLOGY_DATA_ABSENT prevents deriving a real eligible Root Universe — qualify what the slm fixture allows, record the blocker, do not fabricate morphology.
